verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party Incident Management doc page, which supports declaring and tracking incidents, and community users describe using notebooks during incidents. The pack offers only that page title and no content on timelines, on-call scheduling or escalation policies, so most of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented incident timelines, on-call schedules, escalation policies, detail on the incident declaration and tracking workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of incident management.
